items.title: 5.5 Surface tension of liquids (liquids ki surface tension) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.5, printed pages 103-104.

blocks.text: Surface tension liquids ki woh property hai jo liquid ke surface ke saath lagne wali force ko batati hai; is force ki wajah se surface ek elastic (lachakdar) sheet ki tarah behave karta hai. Yeh force surface ke molecules ke darmiyan intermolecular forces se paida hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Patle bhoore jism aur chhe lambi patli tangon wala machhar halke neele pani par khara hai. Jahan har taang pani ko chhooti hai wahan satah zara neeche dabti hai aur chhota sa daira banta hai, lekin satah tootti nahi; machhar ka saya neeche pani par hai.
blocks.caption: Machhar (mosquito) pani ki zyada surface tension ki wajah se pani ki satah par khara reh sakta hai (kitab ki chhapi tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Surface ke molecules ko intermolecular forces kul mila kar andar ki taraf khinchti hain, is liye surface par ek "skin" (jhilli) si ban jati hai. Surface tension ki wajah se liquid apna surface area kam se kam rakhna chahta hai; isi liye droplets (qatre) sphere (gol) bante hain. Capillary action, wetting (cheezon ka geela hona), aur droplets aur bubbles (bulbule) ka banna, sab par surface tension ka asar hai. Machhar (mosquito) pani ki zyada surface tension ki wajah se pani par khara reh sakta hai.
